heroHeading: Dentistry that puts you at ease.
heroText: Warm, unhurried dentistry in the heart of Central Otago. Four modern surgeries behind a historic Alexandra stone facade, and a team that has looked after these smiles for generations.
heroImageAlt: Alexandra and the Clutha River, Central Otago
practiceImageAlt: Illustration of the Tarbert Street Dental team at the practice reception

faqs.question: I have put off the dentist for years. Will I get a lecture?
faqs.answer: No. Plenty of our patients arrive after a long gap and most are nervous about it. We start with a proper look and a chat, sort out anything urgent, then work through the rest at a pace that suits you and your budget.

faqs.question: Can I really get a crown in one appointment?
faqs.answer: Yes. With CEREC we scan the tooth, design the crown on screen and mill it from a ceramic block here in the surgery, then fit it the same day. Most appointments run one to two hours.

faqs.question: What does it cost, and how do I pay?
faqs.answer: You get a written estimate before any treatment starts, so there are no surprises. We accept cash, major cards, Eftpos, bank transfer and Q Card.

faqs.question: Do you see children and teenagers?
faqs.answer: We do, and we love it. We are happy to book families in back to back so it is one trip into town.

heritageText: {years} years of caring for our community. A proud history, familiar faces, and modern dentistry — right here in Alexandra.
